title: Katy Perry’s Lifetimes Tour Concert Film Is Coming to Theaters Worldwide
summary: The movie first premiered at the Tribeca Festival in June.
contentText:
Katy Perry ‘s Lifetimes Tour is going from big stages to big screens, with the pop star announcing Thursday (July 23) that her concert film is finally headed to theaters worldwide.

Related

Could Katy Perry’s ‘143’ Album End Up Belatedly Becoming the Secret Pop Gem of Summer 2026?

The Lifetimes Tour – Live From Paris will be available to view in cinemas and in IMAX for a limited time only starting Sept. 2. Screenings are set for a total of 70 countries, including the U.S., the U.K., Ireland, Italy, Brazil, Mexico, Germany, France and Australia.

“We’re thrilled to bring this one-of-a-kind experience to KatyCats around the world,” producer Daniel E. Catullo III said in a statement. “More than a million fans experienced this tour live, and now millions more will have the opportunity to see it like never before on the big screen … The response to the film has been extraordinary, and we’re excited to share this unforgettable concert experience with audiences everywhere. It’s Katy’s love letter to her fans.”

Filmed during Perry’s two November performances at Accor Arena in Paris, the Lifetimes Tour movie first premiered at the Tribeca Festival in June. The singer was present at the event and sat for a Q&A accompanying the screening, during which she gushed about boyfriend Justin Trudeau, whom she called “the love of my life.”

Perry and the former Canadian prime minister met while the hitmaker was in the midst of her Lifetimes Tour, which kicked off in April 2025 in support of her 143 album; the project peaked at No. 6 on the Billboard 200. She wrapped the trek in December with $134 million in gross ticket sales , her team said in January.

According to a release, the movie was shot using 60 individual cameras. “The film moves far beyond the traditional concert film, soaring above, around and through the show to place audiences at the heart of the performance,” reads the description. “Every breathtaking aerial moment, explosive visual and roar of the crowd is experienced from perspectives impossible to witness from the arena alone.”

More information about The Lifetimes Tour – Live From Paris theater dates is available on the film’s website .
